title: Auction-based allocation of routes in capacity-constrained networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the route-set allocation problem between end nodes in capacity-constrained flow networks with transfer costs. We introduce an origin--destination (OD) bidding language, in which a participant bids for bounded conic combinations of inlet--outlet--quantity licences and the mechanism performs the routing through a network-flow optimising winner-determination problem. We then study payment rules for the OD mechanism. Under a restricted model with openly and uniformly priced sources and bidders who are indifferent to the source of the gas, the Vickrey--Clarke--Groves (VCG) payment is core-stable; the key structural fact is that in this regime some optimal aggregate flows never use a physical pipe in both directions, so the winner-determination problem reduces to a single-commodity network flow whose value is submodular in the set of active bidders. If source access is allowed to depend on the individual consumer -- a realistic featur

translated_title: 容量受限网络中基于拍卖的路径分配
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有转移成本的容量受限流网络中端节点之间的路径集分配问题。我们引入了一种起讫点（OD）竞价语言，其中参与者对入口-出口-数量许可证的有界锥组合进行竞价，而该机制通过网络流优化的赢家确定问题来执行路由。随后我们研究了OD机制的支付规则。在气源公开且统一定价、竞价者对气体来源不加区分的受限模型下，Vickrey–Clarke–Groves（VCG）支付具有核稳定性；其中的关键结构性事实在于，在该情形下某些最优聚合流从不在同一物理管道的双向上同时使用，因此赢家确定问题可简化为单商品网络流问题，其价值在活跃竞价者集合上具有次模性。若允许气源访问因个体消费者而异——一个符合现实的特征……
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向容量受限流网络的OD竞价语言与拍卖机制，并证明在气源统一定价条件下赢家确定问题可归约为次模的单商品网络流，从而使VCG支付具有核稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an OD bidding language and auction mechanism for allocating routes in capacity-constrained flow networks, proving that VCG payments are core-stable because the winner-determination problem reduces to a submodular single-commodity network flow under uniform source pricing.
